run_glue_mrpc_main: run the Glue_MRPC main function to generate 16-shot MRPC dataset splits for multiple random seeds
create_glue_mrpc_dataset: create a Glue_MRPC dataset instance to load and preprocess the GLUE MRPC paraphrase classification dataset
load_glue_mrpc_dataset: load the GLUE MRPC dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method of Glue_MRPC
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face MRPC dataset split to a list of sentence pair tuples with equivalence labels
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the Glue_MRPC dataset using generate_k_shot_data
